examples.text: Was sich draußen in den Konzentrationslagern des Reiches an Häftlingen aus dem Generalgouvernement befindet, das soll uns zur AB-Aktion zur Verfügung gestellt oder dort erledigt werden.
examples.translation: Any prisoners from the General Government who are outside in the concentration camps of the Reich should be made available to us for the AB-operation or dealt with there.
examples.english: Any prisoners from the General Government who are outside in the concentration camps of the Reich should be made available to us for the AB-operation or dealt with there.

examples.text: »Jeder Versuch der Gerichtsbehörden, sich in die mit Hilfe der Polizei ergriffene AB-Aktion einzumischen, muß als Verrat am Staat und an deutschen Interessen betrachtet werden.«
examples.translation: "Any attempt by the judicial authorities to interfere with the AB-action taken with the assistance of the police must be regarded as treason against the state and German interests."
examples.english: "Any attempt by the judicial authorities to interfere with the AB-action taken with the assistance of the police must be regarded as treason against the state and German interests."

examples.text: Die Akten zeigen, Herr Angeklagter, daß Sie zur Zeit, als der Angeklagte Frank dieses AB-Aktion erörterte, anwesend waren und die Erklärung abgaben, die ich soeben in das Protokoll verlesen habe.
examples.translation: The records show, Mr. Defendant, that you were present at the time when the defendant Frank discussed this AB-operation and made the statement which I have just read into the record.
examples.english: The records show, Mr. Defendant, that you were present at the time when the defendant Frank discussed this AB-operation and made the statement which I have just read into the record.
